# Assumptions: staff_attributes has a row 'Country' (case-insensitive) with countries for staff_1..staff_7; conference_staff contains space-separated confID-staffID pairs like "5-5"; conferences has attr='Conference_ID' mapping.

# 1) Map conference IDs to names
sql_conf_ids = """
SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS conf_id, conf
FROM conferences
WHERE LOWER(attr) = 'conference_id'
"""
conf_map_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql_conf_ids)

# 2) Unpivot staff countries
sql_staff_country_long = """
WITH src AS (
  SELECT * FROM staff_attributes WHERE LOWER(attribute) = 'country'
), long AS (
  SELECT 1 AS staff_id, staff_1 AS country FROM src UNION ALL
  SELECT 2, staff_2 FROM src UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, staff_3 FROM src UNION ALL
  SELECT 4, staff_4 FROM src UNION ALL
  SELECT 5, staff_5 FROM src UNION ALL
  SELECT 6, staff_6 FROM src UNION ALL
  SELECT 7, staff_7 FROM src
)
SELECT staff_id, country FROM long
"""
staff_country_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql_staff_country_long)

# Register temp tables for joining
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, conf_map_df, "tmp_conf_map")
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, staff_country_df, "tmp_staff_country")

# 3) Explode conference_staff safely using DuckDB list functions, then filter to Canada and map to names
sql_final = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH tokens AS (
  SELECT list_transform(regexp_split_to_array(conference_staff, ' +'), x -> x) AS toks
  FROM conference_staff
), exploded AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(split_part(t, '-', 1) AS INTEGER) AS conf_id,
    CAST(split_part(t, '-', 2) AS INTEGER) AS staff_id
  FROM tokens, toks AS t
), canada_staff AS (
  SELECT staff_id FROM tmp_staff_country WHERE LOWER(country) = 'canada'
)
SELECT DISTINCT m.conf AS conference_name
FROM exploded e
JOIN canada_staff cs ON e.staff_id = cs.staff_id
JOIN tmp_conf_map m ON e.conf_id = m.conf_id
ORDER BY conference_name
"""

db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql_final)
